evidence.text: Importing values from a .env file and typing a value at a masked prompt are value-bearing steps that must run where only the person can see them.
The assistant is meant to drive the whole setup flow end to end without the person orchestrating steps.
Over MCP the assistant cannot answer terminal prompts and must never see a prompt that shows or takes a value.

desiredImprovement: The assistant drives the entire setup flow
worseningOutcome: Value-bearing steps must stay outside anything the assistant can observe
